include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND krakensdr_v2_sources
    krakensdr_source_impl.cc
    doa_music_impl.cc
    correlator_impl.cc
)

set(krakensdr_v2_sources
    "${krakensdr_v2_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT krakensdr_v2_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT krakensdr_v2_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-krakensdr_v2 SHARED ${krakensdr_v2_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-krakensdr_v2
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    Eigen3::Eigen
    fftw3f::fftw3f
    Threads::Threads)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-krakensdr_v2
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-krakensdr_v2 PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_krakensdr_v2_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-krakensdr_v2 PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-krakensdr_v2)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################

endif(NOT test_krakensdr_v2_sources)
